title: Managed Google OAuth broker for governed WordPress Context Authority

phases.objective: Provide a server-managed Google OAuth broker for WordPress managed_google mode while preserving exact environment isolation, secret custody, one-time handoff semantics, and fail-closed Production authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed WordPress Site Control Plane plus MAD4B OAuth broker
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An allowlisted non-production WordPress Site Profile can obtain a verifier-bound one-time Google OAuth handoff without receiving the broker Google Client Secret, while Production mutation remains unauthorized and live Staging certification remains required.
steps: Classify the exact base-to-head broker source changes against canonical environment-impact policy.
Require exact server-owned site_uuid + canonical origin + callback binding before creating an OAuth session.
Exchange the Google authorization code only at the broker-owned HTTPS callback using broker-only Google credentials.
Return only a one-time handoff code to WordPress and redeem it server-to-server with the original verifier.
Erase the encrypted transient token envelope atomically on successful redemption and reject replay.
Route refresh through the broker without exposing its Google Client Secret to WordPress.
Verify shared-runtime changes declare both Staging and Production impact while Production mutation remains disabled.
assertions: Staging and Production are both declared because broker runtime and migration source are shared.
Cross-environment review is explicit and live Staging certification remains required.
Google OAuth Client Secret remains broker-owned and is never returned to WordPress.
Site binding is server-owned and exact; caller-only site_uuid/origin claims are insufficient.
Handoff redemption is verifier-bound, one-time, transactional, and replay fails closed.
Only the exact read_only->drive.readonly and read_write->drive scope mappings are accepted.
No Breakglass, Production deployment, Production database apply, provider mutation, or WordPress write authority is granted by this declaration.
